User\n**Purpose**: Represents all users in the system (customers, staff, admins)\n\n**Properties**:\n```csharp\npublic int Id { get; set; }\npublic string Email { get; set; }\npublic string PasswordHash { get; set; }\npublic string FirstName { get; set; }\npublic string LastName { get; set; }\npublic string PhoneNumber { get; set; }\npublic UserRole Role { get; set; }  // Enum: Customer, Staff, Admin\npublic DateTime CreatedAt { get; set; }\n```\n\n**Navigation Properties** (Related Data):\n- `Staff` - If user is staff, links to Staff entity (1-to-1)\n- `CustomerReservations` - Reservations made by this customer (1-to-many)\n- `Reviews` - Reviews written by this customer (1-to-many)\n\n**Example**:\n```csharp\nvar user = new User \n{ \n    FirstName = \"John\", \n    Email = \"john@email.com\", \n    Role = UserRole.Customer \n};\n```\n\n---\n\n### 2. UserRole (Enum)\n**Purpose**: Defines the role/type of user\n\n**Values**:\n```csharp\nCustomer  // Can book reservations\nStaff     // Works at salon\nAdmin     // Manages salon\n```\n\n**Usage**:\n```csharp\nif (user.Role == UserRole.Staff) { /* staff only logic */ }\n```\n\n---\n\n### 3. HairSalon\n**Purpose**: Represents a physical hair salon location\n\n**Properties**:\n```csharp\npublic int Id { get; set; }\npublic string Name { get; set; }\npublic string Address { get; set; }\npublic string PhoneNumber { get; set; }\npublic string Email { get; set; }\npublic DateTime CreatedAt { get; set; }\n```\n\n**Navigation Properties**:\n- `Staff` - All staff members working at this salon (1-to-many)\n- `Services` - All services offered by this salon (1-to-many)\n\n**Relationships**:\n- ONE salon has MANY staff members\n- ONE salon has MANY services\n\n**Example**:\n```csharp\nvar salon = new HairSalon \n{ \n    Name = \"Premium Cuts Downtown\", \n    Address = \"123 Main Street\" \n};\nsalon.Staff.Add(staffMember);\nsalon.Services.Add(service);\n```\n\n---\n\n### 4. Staff\n**Purpose**: Represents a staff member at a salon\n\n**Properties**:\n```csharp\npublic int Id { get; set; }\npublic int UserId { get; set; }              // Foreign Key\npublic int HairSalonId { get; set; }         // Foreign Key\npublic string Specialization { get; set; }   // e.g., \"Hair Coloring\"\npublic decimal HourlyRate { get; set; }\npublic bool IsAvailable { get; set; }\n```\n\n**Navigation Properties**:\n- `User` - Links to User entity (1-to-1)\n- `HairSalon` - Links to HairSalon entity (many-to-1)\n- `Reservations` - All reservations for this staff member (1-to-many)\n\n**Relationships**:\n- ONE user can be ONE staff member (one-to-one)\n- MANY staff members work at ONE salon (many-to-one)\n- ONE staff member has MANY reservations (one-to-many)\n\n**Example**:\n```csharp\nvar staff = new Staff \n{ \n    UserId = 5,\n    HairSalonId = 1,\n    Specialization = \"Hair Coloring\",\n    HourlyRate = 50m\n};\n```\n\n---\n\n### 5. Service\n**Purpose**: Represents a service offered by a salon\n\n**Properties**:\n```csharp\npublic int Id { get; set; }\npublic int HairSalonId { get; set; }         // Foreign Key\npublic string Name { get; set; }\npublic string Description { get; set; }\npublic decimal Price { get; set; }\npublic int DurationMinutes { get; set; }\npublic ServiceCategory Category { get; set; }  // Enum\n```\n\n**Navigation Properties**:\n- `HairSalon` - Salon offering this service (many-to-1)\n- `Reservations` - All reservations for this service (1-to-many)\n\n**Relationships**:\n- MANY services belong to ONE salon (many-to-one)\n- ONE service has MANY reservations (one-to-many)\n\n**Example**:\n```csharp\nvar service = new Service \n{ \n    HairSalonId = 1,\n    Name = \"Hair Coloring\",\n    Price = 120m,\n    DurationMinutes = 120,\n    Category = ServiceCategory.Coloring\n};\n```\n\n---\n\n### 6. ServiceCategory (Enum)\n**Purpose**: Categorizes types of services\n\n**Values**:\n```csharp\nHairCut\nColoring\nStyling\nTreatment\nBeard\nNails\nFacialTreatment\n```\n\n**Usage**:\n```csharp\nif (service.Category == ServiceCategory.HairCut) { /* ... */ }\n```\n\n---\n\n### 7. Reservation\n**Purpose**: Represents a booking made by a customer\n\n**Properties**:\n```csharp\npublic int Id { get; set; }\npublic int CustomerId { get; set; }          // Foreign Key (User)\npublic int StaffId { get; set; }             // Foreign Key\npublic int ServiceId { get; set; }           // Foreign Key\npublic DateTime ReservationDateTime { get; set; }\npublic ReservationStatus Status { get; set; }  // Enum\npublic string Notes { get; set; }\npublic DateTime CreatedAt { get; set; }\n```\n\n**Navigation Properties**:\n- `Customer` - The customer making the reservation (many-to-1 User)\n- `Staff` - Staff member assigned to reservation (many-to-1)\n- `Service` - Service being booked (many-to-1)\n- `Reviews` - Reviews for this reservation (1-to-many)\n\n**Relationships**:\n- MANY reservations belong to ONE customer (many-to-one with User)\n- MANY reservations assigned to ONE staff (many-to-one)\n- MANY reservations for ONE service (many-to-one)\n- ONE reservation has MANY reviews (one-to-many)\n\n**Example**:\n```csharp\nvar reservation = new Reservation \n{ \n    CustomerId = 1,\n    StaffId = 2,\n    ServiceId = 3,\n    ReservationDateTime = new DateTime(2026, 4, 5, 10, 0, 0),\n    Status = ReservationStatus.Confirmed,\n    Notes = \"First time customer\"\n};\n```\n\n---\n\n### 8. ReservationStatus (Enum)\n**Purpose**: Tracks the status of a reservation\n\n**Values**:\n```csharp\nPending      // Waiting for confirmation\nConfirmed    // Confirmed appointment\nCompleted    // Service completed\nCancelled    // Customer cancelled\nNoShow       // Customer didn't show up\n```\n\n**Usage**:\n```csharp\nvar confirmed = reservations\n    .Where(r => r.Status == ReservationStatus.Confirmed)\n    .ToList();\n```\n\n---\n\n### 9. Review\n**Purpose**: Customer reviews for completed services\n\n**Properties**:\n```csharp\npublic int Id { get; set; }\npublic int ReservationId { get; set; }       // Foreign Key\npublic int CustomerId { get; set; }          // Foreign Key (User)\npublic int Rating { get; set; }              // 1-5 stars\npublic string Comment { get; set; }\npublic DateTime CreatedAt { get; set; }\n```\n\n**Navigation Properties**:\n- `Reservation` - The reservation being reviewed (many-to-1)\n- `Customer` - The customer who wrote the review (many-to-1 User)\n\n**Relationships**:\n- MANY reviews for ONE reservation (many-to-one)\n- MANY reviews written by ONE customer (many-to-one with User)\n\n**Example**:\n```csharp\nvar review = new Review \n{ \n    ReservationId = 5,\n    CustomerId = 1,\n    Rating = 5,\n    Comment = \"Excellent service!\"\n};\n```\n\n---\n\n## Entity Relationship Diagram\n\n```\nUser (1) ‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ÊÂ (1) Staff ‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ˆ«‘ÊÂ (1) Controller calls the repository: `var users = _userRepo.GetAll();`\n2. Passes the model to the view: `return View(users);`\n3. View declares the model type at the top: `@model List<manage_my_hairsaloon.Models.User>`\n4. View iterates or displays the data with Razor syntax: `@user.FirstName`\n\nExample for a detail page:\n\n```csharp\n// Controller\npublic IActionResult Details(int id)\n{\n    var salon = _salonRepo.GetById(id);\n    if (salon == null) return NotFound();\n    return View(salon);       // passes HairSalon object to view\n}\n```\n\n```html\n<!-- View -->\n@model manage_my_hairsaloon.Models.HairSalon\n\n<h1>@Model.Name</h1>\n<p>@Model.Address</p>\n\n@foreach (var staff in Model.Staff)\n{\n    <p>@staff.User?.FirstName ‘«ˆ @staff.Specialization</p>\n}\n```\n\n### Views folder structure\n\n```\nViews/\n  Home/           Index.cshtml (dashboard)\n  Users/          Index.cshtml, Details.cshtml\n  HairSalons/     Index.cshtml, Details.cshtml\n  Staff/          Index.cshtml, Details.cshtml\n  Services/       Index.cshtml, Details.cshtml\n  Reservations/   Index.cshtml, Details.cshtml\n  Reviews/        Index.cshtml, Details.cshtml\n  Shared/         _Layout.cshtml (nav + page shell)\n```\n\n### Back navigation (returnUrl pattern)\n\nWhen navigating from a detail page to a child detail page, a `returnUrl` query parameter is passed:\n\n```html\n<a asp-controller=\"Staff\" asp-action=\"Details\"\n   asp-route-id=\"@staff.Id\"\n   asp-route-returnUrl=\"@Context.Request.PathBase@Context.Request.Path\">\n   Details\n</a>\n```\n\nThe target detail page reads it and uses it for the back link:\n\n```csharp\nvar returnUrl = Context.Request.Query[\"returnUrl\"].FirstOrDefault();\n```\n\n```html\n@if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(returnUrl) && Url.IsLocalUrl(returnUrl))\n{\n    <a href=\"@returnUrl\">‘Ê… Back</a>\n}\nelse\n{\n    <a asp-controller=\"Staff\" asp-action=\"Index\">‘Ê… Back to Staff</a>\n}\n```\n\n`Url.IsLocalUrl()` validates the URL to prevent open-redirect attacks.\n\n---\n\n## UI / Styling\n\nAll styling lives in `wwwroot/css/site.css`. Handles wiring controller actions, repository calls, ModelState validation (server-side), and Razor view markup. Use for any task that involves collecting input from the user and persisting it to the database or filtering data.\"\nargument-hint: \"Describe the form to create, e.g. 'create reservation form' or 'edit service form'\"\n---\n\n# Form Skill ‘«ˆ manage-my-hairsaloon\n\nHandles end-to-end form creation for this ASP.NET Core MVC app: Razor view markup, controller actions (GET + POST), repository layer calls, and server-side ModelState validation.\n\n## Project Conventions\n\n| Convention | Value |\n|---|---|\n| Namespace | `manage_my_hairsaloon` |\n| ORM | Entity Framework Core 8 via `AppDbContext` |\n| Data access | Repository pattern ‘«ˆ always go through the interface, never inject `AppDbContext` into controllers |\n| Route convention | `{Controller}/{Action}/{id?}` (default) ‘«ˆ use `[HttpGet(\"...\")]` for custom slug routes |\n| Validation | Server-side only: Data Annotations on models + `ModelState.IsValid` in POST actions |\n| View location | `Views/{ControllerName}/{ActionName}.cshtml` |\n| Shared layout | `Views/Shared/_Layout.cshtml` ‘«ˆ all views inherit it via `_ViewStart.cshtml` |\n| CSS classes | `btn-outline-brass`, `input-barbershop`, `table-barbershop`, `badge-brass`, `card-barbershop`, `filter-bar` |\n\n## When to Use This Skill\n\n- Creating a **Create** form (`GET` renders empty form, `POST` saves to DB)\n- Creating an **Edit** form (`GET` loads existing record, `POST` updates DB)\n- Adding a **Delete** confirmation + action\n- Adding a **filter/search** form (GET only, calls read-only repository methods)\n- Wiring a new form action to an existing or new repository method\n\n---\n\n## Step-by-Step: POST Form (Create / Edit / Delete)\n\n### Step 1 ‘«ˆ Add Data Annotations to the Model\n\nAdd validation attributes to the model class. Models are in `Models/`.\n\n```csharp\nusing System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;\n\npublic class HairSalon\n{\n    public int Id { get; set; }\n\n    [Required(ErrorMessage = \"Name is required.\")]\n    [StringLength(100)]\n    public string? Name { get; set; }\n\n    [Required]\n    public string? Address { get; set; }\n\n    [Phone]\n    public string? PhoneNumber { get; set; }\n\n    [EmailAddress]\n    public string? Email { get; set; }\n\n    public DateTime CreatedAt { get; set; }\n    // navigation properties stay as-is\n}\n```\n\n> Only annotate scalar properties. Never annotate navigation properties (`List<Staff>`, etc.).\n\n### Step 2 ‘«ˆ Add Repository Write Methods\n\nCheck [repository-api.md](./references/repository-api.md) to see what already exists.  \nIf the needed method (e.g. `Add`, `Update`, `Delete`) is missing:\n\n1. Add the method signature to the **interface** in `Repositories/I{Entity}Repository.cs`\n2. Implement it in `Repositories/{Entity}Repository.cs` using `AppDbContext`\n\n**Standard write method patterns:**\n\n```csharp\n// Interface\nvoid Add(HairSalon salon);\nvoid Update(HairSalon salon);\nvoid Delete(int id);\n\n// Implementation (inject AppDbContext via constructor)\npublic void Add(HairSalon salon)\n{\n    _context.HairSalons.Add(salon);\n    _context.SaveChanges();\n}\n\npublic void Update(HairSalon salon)\n{\n    _context.HairSalons.Update(salon);\n    _context.SaveChanges();\n}\n\npublic void Delete(int id)\n{\n    var salon = _context.HairSalons.Find(id);\n    if (salon != null)\n    {\n        _context.HairSalons.Remove(salon);\n        _context.SaveChanges();\n    }\n}\n```\n\n> `SaveChanges()` must be called explicitly ‘«ˆ EF does not auto-save.\n\n### Step 3 ‘«ˆ Add Controller Actions\n\nSee [controller-patterns.md](./references/controller-patterns.md) for the full patterns.\n\n**Create (GET + POST):**\n```csharp\n// GET: /HairSalons/Create\npublic IActionResult Create()\n{\n    // Populate ViewBag dropdowns here if needed (see Step 3a)\n    return View();\n}\n\n// POST: /HairSalons/Create\n[HttpPost]\n[ValidateAntiForgeryToken]\npublic IActionResult Create(HairSalon model)\n{\n    if (!ModelState.IsValid)\n        return View(model);   // re-render form with validation errors\n\n    model.CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;\n    _salonRepo.Add(model);\n    return RedirectToAction(nameof(Index));\n}\n```\n\n**Edit (GET + POST):**\n```csharp\n// GET: /HairSalons/Edit/5\npublic IActionResult Edit(int id)\n{\n    var salon = _salonRepo.GetById(id);\n    if (salon == null) return NotFound();\n    return View(salon);\n}\n\n// POST: /HairSalons/Edit/5\n[HttpPost]\n[ValidateAntiForgeryToken]\npublic IActionResult Edit(int id, HairSalon model)\n{\n    if (id != model.Id) return BadRequest();\n    if (!ModelState.IsValid)\n        return View(model);\n\n    _salonRepo.Update(model);\n    return RedirectToAction(nameof(Index));\n}\n```\n\n**Delete (GET confirmation + POST):**\n```csharp\n// GET: /HairSalons/Delete/5\npublic IActionResult Delete(int id)\n{\n    var salon = _salonRepo.GetById(id);\n    if (salon == null) return NotFound();\n    return View(salon);\n}\n\n// POST: /HairSalons/Delete/5\n[HttpPost, ActionName(\"Delete\")]\n[ValidateAntiForgeryToken]\npublic IActionResult DeleteConfirmed(int id)\n{\n    _salonRepo.Delete(id);\n    return RedirectToAction(nameof(Index));\n}\n```\n\n#### Step 3a ‘«ˆ Dropdown Lists (SelectLists for FK fields)\n\nWhen a form field is a foreign key (e.g. `HairSalonId` on a `Service`), pass the list via `ViewBag`:\n\n```csharp\n// In GET action, before return View():\nViewBag.Salons = new SelectList(_salonRepo.GetAll(), \"Id\", \"Name\");\n// In POST action, if ModelState.IsValid fails, repopulate before return View(model):\nViewBag.Salons = new SelectList(_salonRepo.GetAll(), \"Id\", \"Name\", model.HairSalonId);\n```\n\nFor enum fields (`ServiceCategory`, `ReservationStatus`), use:\n```csharp\nViewBag.Categories = new SelectList(Enum.GetValues<ServiceCategory>());\n```\n\n### Step 4 ‘«ˆ Create the Razor View\n\n**Create / Edit form template:**\n```html\n@model manage_my_hairsaloon.Models.HairSalon\n@{\n           </select>\n            <span asp-validation-for=\"HairSalonId\" class=\"text-danger\" style=\"font-size:0.8rem;\"></span>\n        </div> *@\n\n        <div style=\"display:flex;
